claim: A non-celebrity specialist method that combines accounting reconstruction, governance evidence, borrow economics and a verifiable catalyst path.
Recompute cash conversion, accrual and related-party indicators from primary filings.
Combine dated borrow availability, cost, crowding and catalyst timing.
Reject any allegation not anchored in an opened primary document.
Reject a short recommendation that cannot be borrowed on modeled terms.
Reject a costly structural short without an observable resolution path.
Excluded claim: anonymous allegations treated as facts
Excluded claim: a claim to represent one famous short seller
Known limit: Borrow availability and cost are broker- and time-specific and may lack durable public history.
Known limit: This is a synthetic professional method seat, not a model of any one person, and source traditions may conflict.
